entries.title: Psalms 33:1
segments: ¶Be glad in the Lord, O doers of righteousness; for praise is beautiful for the upright.

entries.title: Psalms 33:2
segments: Give praise to the Lord on the corded instrument; make melody to him with instruments of music.

entries.title: Psalms 33:3
segments: Make a new song to him; playing expertly with a loud noise.

entries.title: Psalms 33:4
segments: For the word of the Lord is upright, and all his works are certain.

entries.title: Psalms 33:5
segments: His delight is in righteousness and wisdom; the earth is full of the mercy of the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 33:6
segments: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the army of heaven by the breath of his mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 33:7
segments: He makes the waters of the sea come together in a mass; he keeps the deep seas in store-houses.

entries.title: Psalms 33:8
segments: Let the earth be full of the fear of the Lord; let all the people of the world be in holy fear of him.

entries.title: Psalms 33:9
segments: For he gave the word, and it was done; by his order it was fixed for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 33:10
segments: The Lord undoes the designs of the nations; he makes the thoughts of the peoples without effect.

entries.title: Psalms 33:11
segments: The Lord's purpose is eternal, the designs of his heart go on through all the generations of man.

entries.title: Psalms 33:12
segments: ¶Happy is the nation whose God is the Lord; and the people whom he has taken for his heritage.

entries.title: Psalms 33:13
segments: The Lord is looking down from heaven; he sees all the sons of men;

entries.title: Psalms 33:14
segments: From his house he keeps watch on all who are living on the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 33:15
segments: He makes all their hearts; their works are clear to him.

entries.title: Psalms 33:16
segments: A king's salvation is not in the power of his army; a strong man does not get free by his great strength.

entries.title: Psalms 33:17
segments: A horse is a false hope; his great power will not make any man free from danger.

entries.title: Psalms 33:18
segments: See, the eye of the Lord is on those in whose hearts is the fear of him, on those whose hope is in his mercy;

entries.title: Psalms 33:19
segments: To keep their souls from death; and to keep them living in time of need.

entries.title: Psalms 33:20
segments: Our souls are waiting for the Lord; he is our help and our salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 33:21
segments: For in him our hearts have joy; in his holy name is our hope.

entries.title: Psalms 33:22
segments: Let your mercy be on us, O Lord, as we are waiting for you.
